title: The Best First Date Tournament
old_caption:
Eight first dates, twelve signs judging, one winner. There's an upset in the semis.
Stay for the final. The winner makes sense.

title: Things that make sense: cold nights
old_caption: Cold nights have a system: blankets, soup, and one Capricorn carrying a spare scarf just in case. Who in your life always has the extra layer?

title: Things that make sense: texting
old_caption: A proofread "on my way.", three voice notes in a row, and a "home safe?" at 11 PM that gets a yes in two seconds. Which texter are you?

title: Things that make sense: first dates
old_caption: Leo shows up with a compliment loaded, Sag swaps dinner for a walk, and Libra picks the place in one second because Libra asked what you like first.

title: Things that make sense: party season
old_caption: Party season, sorted: Aries opens the dance floor, Gemini knows every name by nine, and Capricorn has both coats ready the second you say you're tired.

title: Things that make sense: love languages
old_caption: Taurus pushes the biggest snack your way. Aries wins the race to the car, then holds the door. Virgo fixes the squeaky door and never mentions it. Which one have you dated?

title: Unpopular opinion: plans are romantic
old_caption: Capricorn said planning a date is romantic and the crowd gasped. Then Sagittarius pulled out a colour-coded planner. Team spontaneous or team Saturday at seven?

title: Unpopular opinion: "I'm not sure yet"
old_caption: Libra climbed onto a crate to defend "I'm not sure yet" and somehow Taurus ended up in tears. An honest maybe beats a rushed yes.

title: Unpopular opinion: the same movie again
old_caption: Taurus says rewatching the same comfort movie is a perfect date. Ten seconds later the whole crowd was on the couch. What's the movie you'd rewatch forever?

title: Unpopular opinion: early nights
old_caption: Virgo, in a nightcap, defending the home-by-ten date. Even Sagittarius yawned and agreed. Early nights are underrated and we will not be taking questions.
